source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Fourth, -LAAX participates in the formation of two tenses in the indicative mood and two tenses in the obligative mood. The difference between (13) and (14) is that present/future obligative denotes an event which must take place either at the moment of speech or right after whereas in the future obligative an event which must take place is located further away in the future.
en: By the way, there had been an episode in the past when I won in the lottery.
